definitions.explanation: A count of one hundred people.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}が{参加|さんか}した。
{参加者|さんかしゃ}の{数|かず}は{百人|ひゃくにん}ぐらいだった。
examples.english: The number of participants was about one hundred.

examples.japanese: {百人|ひゃくにん}{以上|いじょう}の{社員|しゃいん}がこの{会議|かいぎ}に{出席|しゅっせき}した。
examples.english: More than one hundred employees attended this meeting.

notes:
{百人|ひゃくにん} is a compound of {百|ひゃく} (one hundred) and the person counter {人|にん}. It is used as a round number for people in everyday contexts.

COUNTING NOTES:
{百|ひゃく} combines regularly with {人|にん}. For multiples, note sound changes:
- {二百人|にひゃくにん}: 200 people
- {三百人|さんびゃくにん}: 300 people (びゃく)
- {六百人|ろっぴゃくにん}: 600 people (ぴゃく)
- {八百人|はっぴゃくにん}: 800 people (ぴゃく)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {百人一首|ひゃくにんいっしゅ}: a famous anthology of 100 poems by 100 poets, also a traditional card game played at New Year
- {百人|ひゃくにん}{以上|いじょう}: more than 100 people

USAGE:
Often used as a benchmark number: {百人|ひゃくにん}に{一人|ひとり} (one in a hundred).
